## Start with the question

A unified portal should help users choose tools without requiring them to know package names first.

| Goal | Recommended starting point |
|---|---|
| Process and transform genotype data | BIGr |
| Use an interactive genomic analysis interface | BIGapp |
| Estimate ploidy, aneuploidy, or large CNV | Qploidy2 |
| Validate pedigrees and assess ancestry | Familia |
| Optimize mate allocation and genetic gain | AlloMate |
| Assign parentage and estimate breed or line composition | BIGpopA |

## Example path

**Targeted genotyping data → quality control → analysis-ready VCF → population structure → GWAS or genomic prediction**

The value of the portal is that this sequence can link across packages while preserving each package's canonical reference documentation.
